mappingNote: Numbering visually checked against the City of Garland diagram. Green candidates compared with the USGS aerial; OSM polygon centroids used where available, otherwise explicit USGS pixel picks. Bridges routes use independent approximate aerial tee/bend picks because the reference site calculates Back Reach from mismatched loop scorecards. No on-course survey or daily pin data. The operator's linked scorecard lists hole 10 as par 4/5 in its main row, with total par 72/73; its Red row and course description use par 4 and total 72. This package uses par 72 with hole 10 par 4. The app cannot vary par by tee, so ratings remain unverified and this course is excluded from handicap estimates. Archival aerial imagery may predate course changes. Live yardages use coordinates, not printed tee lengths.
